partners.mechanism_chain: COL4A4 (HGNC:2211) —DISRUPTS→ Type IV collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0030199); COL5A2 (HGNC:2221) —DISRUPTS→ Type V collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0030199); Type IV collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0030199) —LEADS_TO→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); Type V collagen synthesis and assembly (GO:0030199) —LEADS_TO→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Hematuria (HP:0011197); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Joint hypermobility (HP:0001382); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Skin hyperextensibility (HP:0001078). Concurrently, mutations in COL5A2 disrupt the synthesis and assembly of type V collagen, which is critical for organizing collagen I fibrils in the extracellular matrix.
